messages:
zoe (AE): Heads up: Prospect 'AtlasBank' approved a POC but legal insists on EU-only for normal ops. They allow an out-of-region DR only after a declared incident with executive signoff + audit. BYO-KMS (Azure KV). They want a short contract snippet, subproc roster, KMS checklist, and a rough pricing delta for "standby DR" vs "EU-reserved" by Friday.

 derek (Solutions Eng): Quick clarifier: do they need log materialized copies to remain in EU always, or can audit logs be exported on DR activation?

 zoe (AE): Audit logs may leave EU only when DR activation is executed. Otherwise everything stays EU.

 talia (Security PM): We'll produce EU subproc roster and SOC2 extracts. For Azure KV BYO-KMS, customer must grant a Redwood SPN wrap/unwrap permissions; we'll provide a one-page checklist and an MOU template covering rotation and emergency access.

 marc (Runtime Eng): Two viable deployment patterns: (1) Tenant pin to EU dedicated pool (strong guarantee, reserved capacity needed), (2) Region-affinity routing with a manual DR activation flow that logs to audit. Option (2) can be demoed in a POC dry-run mode (simulate fallback without flipping traffic).

 ivy (Sales Eng): Can engineering provide a tiny routing policy snippet we can show legal to make the DR activation process explicit?

 marc (Runtime Eng): Snippet for appendix (as plain text): {"policy":"tenant_route","tenant":"AtlasBank","primary":"eu-west-1","fallback":"us-east-1","fallback_activation":"manual","audit_log":true} — this enforces EU primary and requires a manual, logged activation for fallback.

 talia (Security PM): Uploading attestation pack and KMS checklist now. cc @legal-bot for the MOU.

 legal-bot: Uploaded atlas_eu_subproc_2026.pdf and azure_kv_checklist.txt to /shared/atlasbank/docs. Draft DR-clause_template.docx saved (access: sales+legal+sec).

 zoe (AE): Pricing ballpark needed: what should I tell them for standby DR vs reserved EU pin?

 marc (Runtime Eng): Ballpark: standby DR (EU-primary hosted, on-demand DR) ~ +10-22% uplift depending on DR frequency and egress; EU reserved/pinned (dedicated pool) ~ +28-48% based on commit and SLA. Precise quote requires peak QPS and retention.

 ops-oncall: EU pool note: eu-west-1 has ~25% spare capacity today; POC pin for limited time OK. No special infra for Azure KV apart from SPN permissions.

 ivy (Sales Eng): I'll ask AtlasBank for peak QPS, daily token volume, and max acceptable RTO so we can tighten numbers. Also propose 3-week POC: 10 days setup (KMS + routing + docs) + 5 days validation + buffer.

 zoe (AE): Great. Action items: talia -> MOU + subproc pack; marc -> routing snippet + dry-run plan; ivy -> demand profile from AtlasBank. Delivery target: Friday EOD. Ping here for blockers.
